_comment: HPC-Performance-AI Level 3 ExaCA benchmark deck (directional solidification, analytic temperature field; the ExaCA upstream example Inp_DirSolidification.json parameters with the decomposition-independent SurfaceSiteDensity substrate). run.sh sets Domain.Nx/Ny/Nz (0 here = filled per scale mode), RandomSeed, Printing.PathToOutput/OutputFile and drops Printing.Interlayer outside smoke mode; nothing else changes between scale modes. Nuclei are placed from one global RNG stream (RandomSeed), so the initial condition is independent of the MPI decomposition.
